tailoring.headline: OMS Lead Engineer & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms including Order Management (OMS) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer based in Karlsruhe, Germany, offering hands-on expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud.

cover_en.subject: Application: OMS Lead Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am very excited to apply for the OMS Lead Engineer role at EPAM Systems. With over 5 years of professional experience in designing and developing enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical knowledge in SAP Commerce Cloud and Order Management.

bullets.label: Order Management & Commerce
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including Order Management (OMS), Promotions Engine, Hotfolders, Cronjobs, and Impex scripts.

bullets.label: Backend & API Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, and developed OCC REST Web Services for third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Database & Integration
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, while optimizing data pipelines using Profisee and DataHub.

bullets.label: Delivery & Collaboration
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, performing code reviews and guiding developers.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, and my earliest start date is 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at EPAM Systems because of your reputation for delivering complex digital transformation and e-commerce engineering solutions for global enterprises. Bringing my 5+ years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud and Order Management expertise from Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to robust backend architectures and high-performing engineering teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and OMS experience, strong Java and Spring skills, and a commitment to high-quality e-commerce engineering.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an SAP Commerce Cloud and OMS developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am keen to discuss the OMS Lead Engineer role. My notice period ends Dec 15, 2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for OMS Lead Engineer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the OMS Lead Engineer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building and maintaining enterprise e-commerce platforms, Order Management systems, and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared for this role.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available to start on 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
